items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Ethel Waters. She starred in the show. ... first Negro group to ever play the Empire

ctx.x: Keith circuit. But you see, I had to dress up like -- kind of like gingham apron things, because they wouldn't accept us Negro girls in smart clothes, you know. That's why Ethel Waters made up like that, a washer woman and things. We had to wear clothes, until finally, along toward the last -- of course, this is later, so I won't talk about that.

But anyhow, I toured with an old apron on, and things like that. And Leroy had on overalls. And Laura had on just a plain, little old ordinary something. They wouldn't let us come out there on big time.
